info.title: GECKO Fleet API
info.description: Fleet maintenance, parts, procurement, tyres and incidents. Log in on the Platform API (POST /auth/login), then Authorize here with its accessToken.

get.summary: The user's fleet permissions per branch (for the route guard, branch pickers and buttons)

put.summary: End an assignment (activeTo) or change its remarks

delete.summary: Remove a branch override (?rowVersion=); the branch falls back to the tenant value. Tenant rows cannot be removed
